title: Citation auditor supports BVerfG case-number pattern
description:
Add a pattern module for German Federal Constitutional Court (BVerfG) case numbers to the citation auditor. The module follows the CitationPattern interface from ADR-0002 Decision 7 and ships in the installed `ccore audit-citations` Python package, consistent with ADR-0002 Decision 1 (runtime) and Decision 2 (thinned marketplace skill plus ccore).

The pattern registers in the ccore pattern registry and exposes the standard parse + candidateUrls methods. URL candidates target `bundesverfassungsgericht.de` per Decision 5. No new dependencies, no second runtime, no new auth surface.

## MoC

| # | AC | MoC | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | BVerfG pattern parses real case numbers | unit | pytest under tests/test_audit_citations.py |
| 2 | Pattern registered in ccore | review | grep finds the registration |
| 3 | URL candidates point at bundesverfassungsgericht.de | unit | assertion on candidate URLs |
acceptance_criteria:
- ccore audit-citations detects BVerfG case numbers (e.g. 1 BvR 123/45)
- The pattern is registered in the ccore registry
- url-candidates returns at least one URL on bundesverfassungsgericht.de for a parsed citation

metadata.intent: Extend the citation auditor with a new jurisdiction (BVerfG) following ADR-0002. Scope IN: new pattern module, registry entry. Scope OUT: snippet-guard changes, new fetchers, new auth flows.
metadata.contracts: Implements the CitationPattern interface from ADR-0002 Decision 7. Runtime: installed ccore audit-citations per ADR-0002 Decision 1.
